question: Where is Morgan Stanley investing in technology for its advisors?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Morgan Stanley management says the firm continues to invest in Wealth, Institutional Securities and Investment Management via human capital and technology, with growth plans embedding the increasing adoption of AI tools throughout the enterprise and inside its client base.
items.quote: We continue to invest in each of our three business segments: Wealth, Institutional Securities, and Investment Management via human capital and technology. Our growth plans embed the increasing adoption of AI tools throughout the enterprise and inside our client base.

items.text: Management states the firm is using its scale to invest in broadening capabilities for financial advisors that are difficult for others to replicate, including alternatives and privates, tax-efficient investing, digitized assets, family office and OCIO, and tailored lending.
items.quote: We are using our scale to invest in broadening capabilities for FAs that are difficult for others to replicate: alternatives and privates, tax-efficient investing, digitized assets, family office and OCIO, and tailored lending.

items.text: Management describes early AI use cases including LeadIQ, an AI-powered lead distribution platform focused on matching workplace and self-directed relationships and facilitating engagement with the firm's financial advisors.
items.quote: These include the DevGen AI tool, which enhances developer efficiency by modernizing code, Parable, an interactive tool that quickly analyzes and summarizes data, and LeadIQ, our AI-powered lead distribution platform, focusing on matching workplace and self-directed relationships and facilitating engagement with our financial advisors.

items.text: Management describes technology priorities for the advisor business as including protecting client assets and resiliency, and notes that world-class technology can help financial advisors by doing a lot of the early work for client decisions.
items.quote: Third, and this is critical, is the ability to protect client assets... if the technology is world-class, folks want to make decisions with their financial advisers based on the complexity and singularity of their own financial needs... that is something that technology can help do a lot of the early work.

items.text: Management describes using technology for both efficiency (cost side) and revenue (including some AI), as part of the investment story in technology, including in the E*TRADE franchise and E*TRADE Pro.
items.quote: We are also using technology to help us from an efficiency perspective, both on the cost and the revenue side. I'd note to you that some of the AI that we've been doing is actually also on the revenue side.

items.text: Management describes that against its platform of self-directed, workplace and advisor-led channels, the firm has built advantages that make technology a differentiator in its favor.
items.quote: And against that platform, we have built a number of advantages that not only allow us to preserve our moat, but actually make technology a differentiator in our favor.

items.text: Management states the firm's scale supports continued investment in future technology, including AI and digital tools, positioning it to lead as the future of wealth management takes shape.
items.quote: while our scale supports continued investment in future technology, including AI and digital tools. Together, these strengths provide us with a powerful competitive advantage that positions us to lead as the future of wealth management takes shape.

items.text: Management describes the firm as having been overweighted to AI from the early days in wealth, citing work done with OpenAI.
items.quote: We were, as you know, overweighted to AI from the early days in wealth with some of the work we did with OpenAI.

items.text: Management describes LeadIQ as using AI to introduce the firm's advisors to clients who are interested in advice, using technology on both the revenue and expense side to drive margin.
items.quote: So LeadIQ, for example, which is helping us introduce our advisors to our clients who are interested in advice, that's happening using AI. So there's technology that can be used both on the revenue side and on the expense side.

items.text: Management describes investing in all processes and systems to build robust infrastructure, across the technology side, better understanding of data, and better servicing of clients.
items.quote: we've been investing in all of our processes and our systems in order to engage and make sure that we have a robust infrastructure... that has to do with everything that I mentioned across the technology side, across better understanding our data, better servicing our clients.

items.text: Morgan Stanley's strategic update deck describes a market-leading platform to power growth for financial advisors.
items.quote: Market Leading Platform to Power Growth for Financial Advisors

cells.reason: Multiple passages contain management's descriptions of technology priorities for the advisor (Wealth Management) business, including AI adoption, advisor capability investments, efficiency and revenue technology, and AI-powered tools like LeadIQ.
